structuralDecisions.decision: Replace the CDN-loaded Turf.js script tag in src/fixture.ts with a load from the package's own local @turf/turf dependency, served statically alongside the fixture page.
structuralDecisions.rationale: AC4 requires the suite to pass under `--network none`. A page.addScriptTag pointed at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net cannot resolve offline, which would fail every helper that depends on window.turf (getMarkersAlongLine, isPointInPolygon, distanceBetween). fixture.ts is this package's adapter boundary (a Playwright fixture wrapping Leaflet's window global); sourcing its runtime library locally instead of from a CDN is a dependency-sourcing fix, not a layer-boundary change.
tradeOffs: Requires shipping a browser-consumable Turf bundle (UMD/IIFE) from node_modules or building one at pretest time, instead of one CDN URL.
@turf/turf becomes a real runtime dependency of the published package, increasing its install footprint for every consumer even if they never call the Turf-backed helpers.

fitness.property: No CDN/network script or link tag reaches the browser from the fixture page or fixture.ts's library loading
fitness.verification: code-reviewer greps for http(s):// inside addScriptTag/<script src>/<link href>; confirmed end-to-end by the AC4 docker run with --network none exiting 0

structuralDecisions.decision: Move @turf/turf into package.json's `dependencies` block (not devDependencies), pinned to ^6 to match the previously CDN-pinned major version.
structuralDecisions.rationale: The code that loads Turf executes inside the browser context under test at runtime, not just at build/test-authoring time on the Node side — that makes it a runtime dependency of the published package, the same category leaflet is already in.
tradeOffs: Every consumer of @orieken/saturday-playwright-leaflet now pulls @turf/turf transitively, whether or not they exercise the three Turf-backed helpers.

fitness.property: package.json lists @turf/turf under dependencies, pinned ^6, and pnpm-lock.yaml reflects it under this package's own dependency block
fitness.verification: code-reviewer greps package.json; pnpm install's lockfile diff is reviewed in the same PR

structuralDecisions.decision: Keep all new test infrastructure (fixtures/index.html, fixtures/serve.mjs, playwright.config.ts, tests/fixture.spec.ts) inside packages/saturday-playwright-leaflet/ itself, following apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/playwright.config.ts's existing chrome/channel/webServer pattern verbatim rather than extracting a shared test-harness package.
structuralDecisions.rationale: This package is the sole owner and sole consumer of the LeafletFixture it's testing; the fixture page has no reuse value outside verifying this package's own public API. CLAUDE.md's architect-skip guidance applies directly: purely additive test infrastructure within an established pattern, no new package or base class.

structuralDecisions.decision: No change to tsconfig.json's existing rootDir ("./src") / include (["src/**/*"]) scoping — fixtures/ and tests/ stay outside the package's own tsc build by construction.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Verified directly by reading tsconfig.json: rootDir and include already scope compilation to src/ only, so the new fixtures/ and tests/ directories are structurally excluded from dist/ without any edit.
